summary: Re-tested the Gemini assistant integration, buyer auth, seeded catalog, wishlist/compare UI, and frontend compilation. Core API and UI flows pass; the configured universal key is rejected by Gemini and the API correctly returns an explicit fallback source.
action_items: Make backend regression tests idempotent: wishlist/compare tests must first normalize toggle state, and registration must use a unique email or clean up its TEST_ account.
critical_code_review_comments: Gemini integration is server-side and attempts the configured key, but EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is not accepted by Google; this run therefore exercised the explicitly mocked/fallback provider path rather than a live Gemini answer.

success_rate.backend: 100% product checks; 33% existing regression suite due non-idempotent tests

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing TEST_reg_lumina@example.com caused the registration regression test to receive 409.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Buyer login, catalog loading, wishlist/compare clicks, assistant modal submission/answer rendering, assistant close, and frontend compilation passed. Existing backend test file needs state normalization before rerun.
rca of the issue: The wishlist and compare APIs are intentional toggles; the regression test assumes an empty initial state, but prior runs already saved p1, so the second toggle removes it. The registration test uses a fixed TEST_ email that already exists from iteration 1, so the API correctly returns 409 duplicate email. Browser automation also had a malformed test-only page.evaluate selector string; product flow itself passed. GEMINI response source was lumina-insights-fallback because the configured universal key was declined by Google, with HTTP 200 and a valid reply preserved.
